description: This file defines a React-based journey/roadmap page component for a web application. It includes the main page component, subcomponents for a mind map visualization, pathway timeline, and various utility functions. The file manages state for role-specific roadmaps, renders an interactive mind map with expandable categories and sub-nodes, and facilitates milestones tracking.

methods.name: safeParseStringArray
methods.description: Parses a raw string from localStorage into an array of strings, handling errors and invalid formats.

methods.name: uid
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier string with a given prefix, combining random and timestamp parts.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Restricts a number to be within a specified inclusive range.

methods.name: todayISO
methods.description: Returns the current date in 'yyyy-mm-dd' ISO format.

methods.name: ProgressPill
methods.description: React component rendering a visual pill indicating progress percentage with color coding.

methods.name: StatusChip
methods.description: React component rendering a colored chip representing a milestone's status.

methods.name: milestoneProgress
methods.description: Calculates numeric progress (0, 50, 100) based on milestone status.

methods.name: milestoneClusterIndex
methods.description: Returns an index (0, 1, 2) to categorize milestones by progress for UI clustering.

methods.name: completionSummary
methods.description: Summarizes milestones into total, done, in progress counts, and completion percentage.

methods.name: progressRingTone
methods.description: Determines ring colors for progress visualization based on completion percentage.

methods.name: PathwayIcon
methods.description: Renders different SVG icons for pathway stages ('check', 'star', 'flag').

methods.name: PathwayTimelineCard
methods.description: React component displaying a timeline of milestones, with editing and management functionalities.

methods.name: seedRolePlan
methods.description: Creates a default role plan object with skill deltas and milestones based on role ID.

methods.name: loadRoadmapState
methods.description: Loads saved roadmap state and plans from localStorage.

methods.name: persistRoadmapState
methods.description: Saves the current roadmap state and plans to localStorage.

methods.name: usePrefersReducedMotion
methods.description: Hook detecting user's preference for reduced motion for accessibility.

methods.name: polarPoint
methods.description: Calculates a point on a circle given center, radius, and angle.

methods.name: mixToWhite
methods.description: Interpolates an RGB color towards white by a given factor.

methods.name: buildCategoriesForRole
methods.description: Constructs role-specific categories and sub-nodes for the mind map visualization.

methods.name: categoryIcon
methods.description: Provides SVG icons for common category labels.

methods.name: curvedPath
methods.description: Generates a quadratic Bezier curve path string with optional curvature for connector lines.

methods.name: getMindMapModel
methods.description: Computes nodes and edges for the 3-layer radial mind map visualization based on role and categories.

methods.name: MindMapTooltip
methods.description: Displays tooltip with milestone info on hover in the mind map.

methods.name: MindMapNodeView
methods.description: Renders individual nodes of the mind map with hover and click interactions.

methods.name: MindMapCanvas3Layer
methods.description: Main component rendering the interactive 3-layer radial mind map visualization.

methods.name: RoadmapJourneyPage
methods.description: Main page component managing a role-based roadmap with tabs for Mind Map and Pathway. Handles state, role selection, and local storage persistence.
